text:
Our field sales team piloted an AI note-taker for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

**Time came back.** Reps saved about five hours a week. Less typing in parking lots, more prep before the next call.

**CRM data improved.** Notes were consistent, so forecasting reviews stopped relying on memory.

**Adoption hinged on trust.** Reps used it more once we made recording consent clear and let them edit summaries.

**Summaries missed nuance.** Tone, hesitation, and side comments still needed a human ear.

**Managers coached differently.** Searching transcripts beat ride-alongs for spotting patterns.

The takeaway: AI doesn't replace judgment in the room. It simply gives reps more time to use theirs with customers.

Would your team pilot one next quarter? What did yours learn?
